claims.claim: ivrit.ai is a Hebrew speech dataset and model organization on Hugging Face publishing Hebrew ASR corpora and Whisper-fine-tuned models.

ivrit.ai is a non-profit providing favorably-licensed Hebrew datasets; as of July 2025 it hosts the world's largest Hebrew audio dataset, over 22,000 hours, free of charge and licensed for commercial model training.
claims.raw_snippet: As of July 2025, we cater the world’s largest Hebrew audio dataset, over 22,000 hours, for commercial model-training use-cases. It is provided free-of-charge.
claims.verified_via: curl (raw README / HuggingFace API / vendor site)

claims.claim: Dicta publishes Hebrew language models on Hugging Face under dicta-il, including the DictaLM and DictaBERT families.
Dicta's homepage is dicta.org.il.
DictaLM 3.0 family includes a 24B variant based on Mistral-Small-3.1, a 12B Nemotron variant based on NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2, and a 1.7B variant based on Qwen3-1.7B (Feb 2026 release).
The Israeli National NLP Program publishes Hebrew evaluation datasets on Hugging Face under HebArabNlpProject.
HebArabNlpProject/HebrewSentiment is a Hebrew sentiment-analysis dataset with Positive / Negative / Neutral labels.
claims.raw_snippet:
# HebrewSentiment

Hebrew sentiment analysis — Positive / Negative / Neutral
claims.verified_via: curl (raw README / HuggingFace API / vendor site)

claims.claim: HeQ is a Modern Hebrew extractive QA dataset of 30,147 questions, following the SQuAD/ParaShoot methodology with paragraphs from Hebrew Wikipedia and Geektime; 21,784 of the questions are answerable.
claims.raw_snippet: HeQ is a question answering dataset in Modern Hebrew, consisting of 30,147 questions.
claims.verified_via: curl (raw README / HuggingFace API / vendor site)

claims.claim: The Etelis/HeQ_v1 HuggingFace mirror hosts HeQ (30,147 Modern Hebrew questions, SQuAD/ParaShoot format, Hebrew Wikipedia + Geektime paragraphs).
claims.raw_snippet: HeQ is a question answering dataset in Modern Hebrew, consisting of 30,147 questions. It follows the format and crowdsourcing methodology of SQuAD and ParaShoot, with paragraphs sourced from Hebrew Wikipedia and Geektime.
claims.verified_via: curl (raw README / HuggingFace API / vendor site)

claims.claim: The Israeli National NLP Program maintains a Hebrew-Resources catalog of datasets and models on GitHub.
ParaShoot is a Hebrew QA dataset from BIU NLP available at github.com/omrikeren/ParaShoot.
Hugging Face hosts the Open Hebrew LLM Leaderboard, a public benchmark suite for Hebrew language models.
The Open Hebrew LLM Leaderboard live space is at huggingface.co/spaces/hebrew-llm-leaderboard/leaderboard.
HeSum is the BIU NLP Hebrew summarization dataset published on Hugging Face under biunlp/HeSum.
BIU NLP (Bar-Ilan University NLP Lab) publishes Hebrew NLP research and datasets at nlp.biu.ac.il.

OSCAR (Open Super-large Crawled Aggregated coRpus) is a multilingual corpus obtained by language classification and filtering of Common Crawl; the OSCAR-2301 HuggingFace dataset is gated (manual approval).
claims.raw_snippet: The Open Super-large Crawled Aggregated coRpus is a huge multilingual corpus obtained by language classification and filtering of the Common Crawl corpus using the Ungoliant architecture.
claims.verification_note: Read via https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/oscar-corpus/OSCAR-2301 because the repo README is access-restricted; the API reports "gated": "manual", which corroborates the skill's statement that access must be requested.
claims.verified_via: curl (raw README / HuggingFace API / vendor site)

claims.claim: CulturaX is a multilingual cleaned web corpus published by uonlp on Hugging Face.
HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-2 is the second iteration of FineWeb, providing high-quality pretraining data for over 1000 languages (Hebrew via the heb_Hebr config).
claims.raw_snippet: This is the second iteration of the popular 🍷 [FineWeb](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb) dataset, bringing high quality pretraining data to over 1000 🗣️ languages.
claims.verified_via: curl (raw README / HuggingFace API / vendor site)
